{{Quote|Are you capable of taking the initiative, Captain?|[[Ysanne Isard]]|<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>}}
'''Lakwii Varrscha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and an officer in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]&mdash;she was a tall, muscular woman who seemed diligent but was generally regarded by her superiors to be no more than ordinarily competent.

==Biography==
Early in her career, Varrscha had been assigned to [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]], where she served as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Imperial Customs Corvette|light corvette]]. Subsequently, she transferred to the line forces of the Navy, and for several years, she served aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Errant Venture/Legends|''Virulence'']] under the command of [[Joak Drysso]], where she achieved the post of executive officer with the rank of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]]. When Drysso was transferred to command the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', she was advanced to replace him, and she commanded the ''Virulence'' during the [[Bacta War]], until [[Booster Terrik]] bluffed her into surrendering at [[Yag-prime|Yag'Dhul Station]].

Most people who encountered Captain Varrscha were left with the impression that she was somewhat uninspired. [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]], who had outrun her corvette once, recalled her tactics as completely conventional, while [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sair Yonka]] of the Star Destroyer [[Freedom|''Avarice'']] noted that the performance of ''Virulence'' under her command was unimpressive: in particular, she had failed to improve her [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]' performance when she knew that she would be faced with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. [[Fliry Vorru]] thought that she had risen as far as she had simply by standing at Drysso's side, and was concerned that command of a Star Destroyer taxed her to the limits of her ability. But considering her willingness to surrender the ''Virulence'' at Yag'Dhul, another interpretation of her lack of zeal is also possible&mdash;Lakwii Varrscha was simply not fully committed to the Imperial service.
